LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_HOSPITAL_STA: You open your eyes groggily. A pungent smell of disinfectant fills the room. You find yourself in a hospital both familiar and strange, tied up from head to toe. Several people in white coats surround you, seemingly saying something. You decide...
Seeing that you are too agitated, the doctor in the white coat gives you a sedative shot...
You feel dizzy again, slowly losing the ability to tell hallucination from reality. Your vision goes black, and you sink back into slumber...
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_CAVE4_DALI_D: You find yourself in a dim cave. A group of young men and women in hemp robes approach. Their leader, a youth calling himself "Xuanyang", holds a fire box and urges you to "go" with him.
"Go? So what you really want is..."
Slip away quickly in the opposite direction and tattle to Master Laizi.
Before you can finish speaking, Xuanyang's group gag you, knock you out, and tie you up, tossing you aside. In the chaos, you pull off Xuanyang's jade pendant...
Add "Xuanyang Jade Pendant" to your relics.
Praising your report, the master rewards you with some pills.
The fleeing disciples of Xuanyang are caught by the master and all slain. The master appoints you as the new "Xuanyang". Your vision goes black...
LIHUOWANG2_EVENT_LIHUOWANG2_AO_JING_JIAO: To deal with the threat of Danyangzi, you come to the cave of the Fire Cult. Led by its followers, you see a man charred black all over, his entire body pierced through by blood-soaked bamboo roots. He calls himself Shou San and agrees to solve your Danyangzi problem - but first, you must demonstrate for them the process of Xin Su's "Dung Beetle Ascension". To push you to the utmost of inner suffering, they arrange for a maidservant named Jiang Yingzi to keep you company, and then...
Discuss the Fire Cult's doctrine and the details of "Dung Beetle Ascension" with Shou San.
This is too cruel. Secretly plan to escape from here with Jiang Yingzi.

Shou San tells you that the ascension condition on the remnant scroll is "1 HP, 0 cards, 0 Energy...". You watch his mouth open and close - clearly speaking, yet impossible to understand. Everything goes black and you pass out...

You cannot bear to see Jiang Yingzi harmed, and try to escape with her in secret. But somehow the plan is exposed, and she is taken away. Barbed hooks pierce through her shoulder blades, hanging her body up. Ignoring your own wounds, you launch a fingernail that cuts the chains holding Yingzi and free her. To thank you, Jiang Yingzi teaches you the Fire Scripture and how to use it.

You reach out and take the strange book wrapped in half-transparent wax. Through the hardened wax, you see its true name: the "Huowo Proverbs Scripture". Inside are words made of circles - big rings around small rings, with tiny dots inside. You slip into a hallucination...
